# Susanoo

> Susanoo is an open-source workflow layer for Claude Code. It reads a coding task, rates its complexity and risk, and routes it to a FAST, STANDARD, or DEEP workflow with mandatory safety controls. With `susanoo init --enforce`, Claude Code hooks deny file edits until the user approves the plan, stop Claude from approving its own plan, and block the end of a turn until required checks have passing, recorded evidence.

Key facts:

- Python 3.11+ CLI and library with zero runtime dependencies; Apache-2.0 license.
- Deterministic: routing uses configurable keyword and rule heuristics in TOML, not a model. Every score lists the reasons that produced it.
- Three workflows: FAST (trivial, low-risk changes), STANDARD (typical features: plan, approval, build, test, review), DEEP (high-risk or complex work: architecture first, explicit plan, isolated implementation, independent review, evidence-backed completion).
- Complexity and risk are separate dimensions, so a small change to password hashing or billing is never treated as routine.
- Mandatory safety controls (security review, data safety, irreversible-action confirmation, sandbox credentials) still apply when a user overrides the workflow.
- Claude Code integration: a `/susanoo` skill, `susanoo-reviewer` and `susanoo-researcher` subagents, and optional hooks, either in the skill (default) or in `.claude/settings.local.json` (`--enforce-scope settings`, which also covers resumed sessions).
- Reference suite: agreement with maintainer labels on 38 of 39 tasks (97.4%), with zero tasks rated below their labeled minimum risk. This measures consistency with stated expectations, not outcome quality.
- Global mode: `susanoo init --global` makes it the default workflow in every project without typing `/susanoo`. Coding prompts are routed automatically, questions pass through, and in autonomous Claude Code permission modes Susanoo asks no questions while still requiring passing checks before Claude finishes.
- Install: `git clone https://github.com/Breadstick-Crumbs/susanoo && cd susanoo && pip install -e .`, then `susanoo init --enforce` in a project and `/susanoo <task>` in Claude Code.
